metadata.description:
"This sound recording captures the President's address on the transfer, under the Lend-Lease Act, of a submarine chaser to the Greek Government. It includes the following: 'Today, Greece is a gaunt and haggard sample of what the Axis is so eager and willing to hand to all the world.'"
